g.text: UC-005 Domain Glossary — Phone List Coordination (CIM)
care to residents during a shift
A physical phone used by caregivers
to the facility, not to people
but the phone itself stays at Slottet.
Each Caregiver works one Shift at a time.
What this glossary does NOT contain:
No "PhoneAssignment" — that is a system construct
that appears in PIM. In the real world there is only
a relationship: a Caregiver carries a Work Phone
during a Shift. No third "thing" exists.
No data types (Guid, String, int) — those are
No methods or operations — concepts don't
No primary keys or foreign keys — these are
database concerns that appear in PSM.
